title: Samsung and SK Hynix reportedly to license YMTC&\#x27;s Xtacking NAND stacking tech
summary: Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix have reportedly agreed, through a cross-licensing arrangement, to use parts of Yangtze Memory Technologies&\#x27; Xtacking technology in their 3D NAND flash. All three companies declined to comment, so the scope, terms, and timing of any agreement are unconfirmed. Xtacking builds the memory-cell array and the CMOS control circuitry on two separate wafers and joins them with a bonding step, allowing each part to be manufactured and optimized independently. An Omdia senior analyst cited in the report said this separation lets a manufacturer produce its own memory array while having the logic die made by a foundry on a more advanced process node.
